notes: πρέπον ἐστίν is taken as one unit for it becometh on rule 73's collapse reasoning, the copula being the verb of general sense and the participle carrying the content; the competing reading gives it becometh to πρέπον and leaves ἐστίν unrepresented, and remains defensible.
The italicized it after Suffer is the verb's supplied object and stays with the verb that governs it under rule 74's contrast, so it is not added.
SBLGNT.MAT.3.15.v011 is underdetermined with r00-base compatible and πρὸς αὐτόν is translated as unto him, so no rule 97 question arises.
